name: Social Feed
tagline: A stream of user-generated activity, completed sessions, achievements, milestones, visible to followers or the community.
desc: For the Socializer, the feed is the reason to open the app beyond the core loop. Strava's feed integrates kudos, photos, achievements, and challenge completions into a coherent activity stream. The mechanic works best when the feed surfaces personally relevant content, activity from people the user knows.
principle: The feed converts private behaviour into social currency. A personal session becomes visible progress in a shared space.
warn: Social feeds require a minimum viable social graph to function. A user with no followers sees an empty feed, which accelerates churn. Seed the social graph during onboarding.
lifecycle: Grows in value as the social graph expands. Low value days 1–7; high value from day 30+.
